comment: zap.c makewish() (6334), wish_history_add() (6235-6253) and wish_history_menu() (6288-6306) once an empty line is in the history. Escape at "For what do you wish?" empties the line (6346-6347), readobjnam("") grants a random object, and wish_history_add("") stores "" in slot 0. wish_history[0] is then a non-null pointer, so `m` ^W opens the menu with one blank entry; Escape there leaves buf empty. The zero-length entry is a prefix of every line (strncmpi() with n = 0), so the later "scalpel" wish is never added and the last menu still lists only the blank entry, which `a` picks.
